updates._help: The 'Latest updates' box on the home page. It shows the newest commits (pushes) from GitHub automatically, mixed with the hand-written entries in 'news' below – 'count' entries in total, newest first; older ones drop out. A commit whose message starts with the hidePrefix (e.g. '- small typo fix') is not shown. Delete 'github' to show only the 'news' entries.
